cohort: Women who underwent cesarean section and received IV oxytocin at the third stage of labor
finding: The use of IM motherwort injection was associated with significantly lower risk of PPH and severe PPH compared to the use of IM oxytocin in women undergoing cesarean section who had received IV oxytocin.
mod_finding: Among women undergoing cesarean section who had received IV oxytocin, the additional use of IM motherwort injection could achieve a lower risk of PPH as compared to the additional use of IM oxytocin.
